title: AvatarMinto
tagline: AvatarMinto allow a wider range of design tools and dynamic avatars. include adding more design elements such as body tones, and facial features, as well as allowing users to upload their own designs
description:
The inspiration behind the AvatarMinto project was to create a dynamic and customizable NFT collection that goes beyond the limitations of traditional pixel art avatars. The project aims to provide users with a wider range of design tools and customization options, including the ability to add more design elements such as body tones and facial features.

Additionally, the AvatarMinto project seeks to empower users by allowing them to upload their own designs and create their own collections, thereby increasing the level of engagement and participation within the community. This approach enables users to create unique and personalized avatars that are truly representative of their individuality.

Overall, the AvatarMinto project was inspired by the desire to create an NFT collection that goes beyond the static and limited nature of traditional pixel art avatars, providing users with greater creative freedom and opportunities for self-expression.
how_its_made: AvatarMinto was built using a combination of React, React-Canvas, and Solidity. React and React-Canvas were used to create the user interface and design tools, while Solidity was used to write the smart contract code that defines the ERC721 tokens and manages their ownership and transfer.
